prompt: Sum an array of 32-bit signed ints. Index with the right scale, widen with sign, and advance the counter.
template:
sum_i32:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.Lloop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jae .Ldone
    {{2}} rdx, dword ptr [rdi + rcx*{{0}}]
    add rax, rdx
    {{1}} rcx
    jmp .Lloop
.Ldone:
    ret
explain: Each element is 4 bytes, so the scale is 4. `movsxd` sign-extends a 32-bit value into 64 bits; negative numbers stay negative. `movzx` cannot take a dword source.
